---
page-layout: full
body-classes: app-page
pagetitle: CensoLab
---

<iframe
  class="app-frame"
  src="https://jbkunst-censolab.share.connect.posit.cloud/"
  title="CensoLab"
  loading="eager"
  allow="clipboard-read; clipboard-write"
></iframe>

<script>
const censolabAnalyticsEvents = new Set([
  "app_loaded",
  "map_analysis_generated",
  "territorial_profile_generated"
]);

window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  if (event.origin !== "https://jbkunst-censolab.share.connect.posit.cloud") return;
  if (event.data?.source !== "censolab-shiny") return;
  if (!censolabAnalyticsEvents.has(event.data?.event)) return;
  if (typeof window.gtag !== "function") return;

  const params =
    event.data?.params && typeof event.data.params === "object" && !Array.isArray(event.data.params)
      ? event.data.params
      : {};

  window.gtag("event", event.data.event, params);
});
</script>
